meta.name: gpt-taste
meta.description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造高级UI动效与排版布局
copy.tagline_en: Create advanced UI animations and typographic layouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue top-tier visual experience and GSAP motion design.

howto.what: 写前端页面时,它先输出一个 <design_plan>,用模拟 Python 随机选定 Hero 布局、字体、组件与 GSAP 动效,再按 AIDA 结构生成带滚动动画的页面。
howto.when: 当你让它做网页 UI、落地页或前端设计时接管;页面需要 AIDA 结构或 GSAP 滚动动效时同样适用。

say.text: 用 gpt-taste 做个产品落地页,先给 design_plan
say.note: 会先输出随机化设计计划,再写代码

say.text: 给这个页面加上 GSAP 滚动固定和卡片堆叠
say.note: 会写真实的 ScrollTrigger 代码

say.text: 把这个 bento 网格改成不留空格的紧密拼接

howto.what_en: When writing front-end pages, it first outputs a <design_plan> that simulates Python random selection of hero layout, font, components and GSAP motion, then builds an AIDA-structured page.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask for web UI, a landing page or front-end design, or when the page needs AIDA structure or GSAP scroll motion.

say_en.text: Build a product landing page with gpt-taste, start with a design_plan
say_en.note: It outputs the randomized plan before any code.

say_en.text: Add GSAP scroll pinning and card stacking to this page
Rework this bento grid so it has no empty cells
